answer: Each agent signs its identity bond with a quill: post a 300 POA jade-sealed bond, which decays 5% per epoch unless renewed by honest work. A plume of audit records tracks every bond, so a cloned identity starts fresh with a worthless bond. Forging 100 identities costs 100 x 300 = 30,000 POA, most of it decaying before it earns. One honest agent pays a single 300 POA bond and keeps its full value by working. Cheap honesty, expensive fakery.
